Training Topic / Competency Item: An applicant who intends to furnish or order drugs shall submit written evidence to the Board that the licensee has completed at least forty-eight (48) hours of instruction in pharmacology that included the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic principles and properties of the drugs to be ordered or furnished under the provisions of the Act.
Purpose: Requires instruction in pharmacology before a naturopathic doctor may furnish or order drugs
Approval Basis: The 48 hours of pharmacology instruction may be offered by an approved naturopathic medical school or by an institution the Board determines equivalent, but equally by any institution of higher learning that offers a baccalaureate or higher degree in medicine, nursing, pharmacy or public health, so no external approval of the instruction is a precondition
Frequency: prior to furnishing or ordering drugs
